name: Gordo's Task
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Master want weeds. Us gots big hands and not good at picking. You help us and we not hurt you. Us need gloom weed. Many weeds around here and near road.

When you have gloom weed you take to Master Holland in Brill graveyard.
narrative.objectives: Collect 3 Gloom Weed and deliver them to Junior Apothecary Holland in the Brill graveyard.
narrative.offerRewardText:
What's this? Gloom weed?! I've no need for gloom weed! That mindless mass of flesh is out there picking daisies and convincing the Lady knows how many dupes like you into doing the same. No offense.

Very well, you're here now and that's all that matters. Since I'm not going to bother to try to explain things to that abomination how about you collect what I really need... doom weed!
narrative.requestItemsText: Where's that useless abomination? Either you have what I need or you'd best get out there and find it.

chain.subtitle: 2 quests from level 5 to 6, 780 XP in all.

quests.name: Gordo's Task
quests.objectiveText: Collect 3 Gloom Weed and deliver them to Junior Apothecary Holland in the Brill graveyard.

quests.name: Doom Weed
quests.objectiveText: Collect 10 Doom Weed and deliver them back to Junior Apothecary Holland.
